name: Haxe
description: Haxe is a cross-platform language and toolkit that compiles to JavaScript, C++, Python, Lua, PHP, Java, and more. It is ideal for building applications that need to run on multiple platforms from a single codebase.

items.title: Haxe Manual (Official)
items.description: The definitive guide covering Haxe syntax, types, macros, and target-specific behaviors.

items.title: Haxe Programming Wikibook
items.description: A community-edited open textbook introducing Haxe and its cross-platform approach.

items.title: Haxe Docs Portal
items.description: Central entry point for all official Haxe tutorials, API docs, and guides.

items.title: Haxe Standard Library API
items.description: Complete API reference for Haxe standard library across all target platforms.

items.description: Official browser-based playground to write Haxe and see compiled outputs for all targets.
